info.title: Factstore API

post.description: Recomputes each signed record's canonical bytes, checks its hash, its link to the record before it and its signature, and reports the first failing sequence number and how many were checked.
post.summary: Verify stored event records over a sequence range

post.description: Covers every signed record since the last checkpoint. 201 with the checkpoint, or 204 when there is nothing new. Checkpoints are also made on a schedule.
post.summary: Checkpoint now

post.description: The plain-text key is returned **once**. Scopes default to a read-only set; pass `preset: CI_PIPELINE` for the common pipeline case. A caller cannot grant scopes it does not itself hold, and the TTL is capped.
post.summary: Create an API key

get.description: Never returns key material. `expiringSoon` and `daysUntilExpiry` let a client warn before a pipeline breaks.
get.summary: List API keys for an owner

get.description: The valid `resource:action` scopes and the presets, so a client does not have to hard-code them.
get.summary: The scope vocabulary

delete.description: Takes effect on the next request: the cached validation is dropped too.

post.description: Issues a replacement with the same scopes and returns its plain text once. The previous key keeps working for the overlap window (default 24h), so a pipeline can roll over without an outage.
post.summary: Rotate an API key

post.description: Revokes the session server-side, so the token stops working immediately rather than at its expiry, and clears the session cookie.
post.summary: End the session

get.description: Answers for both a user session and an API key. Returns 401 when unauthenticated — never an anonymous placeholder.
get.summary: The authenticated principal, its organisation, role and permissions

post.description: Every subsequent request is scoped to it. Refused unless the user is a member of the target organisation.
post.summary: Switch the organisation this session acts in

post.description: Bounded by the session's absolute lifetime, so a session cannot be renewed indefinitely.
post.summary: Extend the session without returning to the identity provider

get.summary: The signed-in user's own active sessions

delete.description: Signing out another device. Revoking someone else's session requires ADMIN.
delete.summary: Revoke one of the signed-in user's own sessions

delete.description: The lever to pull when an account is compromised or someone leaves.
delete.summary: Revoke every active session for a user (administrator)

get.summary: List a user's active sessions (administrator)

post.description: Must be a different administrator from the requester (403 otherwise). Irreversible: every fact encrypted under the key becomes unreadable (410). Returns the destruction certificate, a ledger record.
post.summary: Approve a shred request and destroy the key

post.description: period is YYYY-MM. 202 with a request that a different administrator must approve; 404 when no key exists; 409 when it is already shredded.
post.summary: Request that a data key be shredded

post.description: 202 when the fact conforms and is accepted. 400 with error invalid_envelope, unknown_schema or schema_nonconformant and a list of violations when it does not; nothing is stored. 409 when the fact_id was already ingested. 401 when X-Signature is missing or does not verify against the trusted signing-key registry (#187).
post.summary: Ingest a fact

post.description: Sent by the CLI once Factstore is reachable again, for each gate it decided by the environment's tier while Factstore was unreachable. 201 with audit_alert_id, or 200 for a report already recorded (same report_id).
post.summary: Report a gate decision the client made by risk tier

put.description: 201 when published, 200 when the same content was already published, 409 when the version exists with different content or breaks compatibility with the previous version, 400 for an invalid JSON Schema or an out-of-order version.
put.summary: Publish a version of a fact schema

post.description: publicKey is an Ed25519 public key in PEM (openssl pkey -pubout). 201 when registered, 400 when it is not an Ed25519 key, 409 when the key id is taken. Rotate by registering a new key id.
post.summary: Register a runner's signing key

post.description: Facts signed with it are refused from now on.
post.summary: Revoke a signing key
